code:
Dana Whitfield — Senior Claims Analyst

  Role: Claims Adjuster       (create + approve claim requests)
  Role: Payment Approver      (approve wire transfers, limit $50,000)

Held together: originate a claim AND approve its own payout.
No second approver required at any point.
caption: Two individually reasonable roles — dangerous only because one account held both.

eyebrow: How it went undetected for 14 months

steps.label: A temporary coverage grant
steps.sub: Payment Approver added during a colleague's leave — never removed

steps.label: No mutual-exclusion rule
steps.sub: Thornbury's RBAC catalog never encoded these roles as conflicting

steps.label: No SoD check running
steps.sub: a human noticing one report line was the only control that caught it

code:
Exposure window:      14 months
Authority limit:      $50,000 per transaction
Claims investigated:  ~230 originated by Dana in that window
Self-approved claims found:  0

Real exposure, real gap -  but no confirmed fraud.
caption: The investigation sizes the risk accurately instead of over- or under-stating it.

steps.label: Immediate
steps.sub: revoke Payment Approver, assign an uninvolved backup approver

steps.label: Preventive control
steps.sub: a nightly SoD check as code, flags the pairing automatically

steps.label: Catalog fix
steps.sub: mutual-exclusion rule added so provisioning blocks it at assignment

subtitle: One final lesson ties identity, authentication, authorization, hardening, and governance together.
